import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings
import gc

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
gc.enable()

# Set paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))

# Feature columns (all except id and target)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]

# Identify categorical columns - f_27 is the only categorical feature
cat_cols = ["f_27"]

# Convert categorical columns to proper format for LightGBM
for col in cat_cols:
    train_df[col] = train_df[col].astype("category")
    test_df[col] = test_df[col].astype("category")

# Prepare data
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Split for validation (80% train, 20% val)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Create LightGBM Datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_tr, label=y_tr, feature_name=feature_cols, categorical_feature=cat_cols
)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data, categorical_feature=cat_cols
)

# Reduced model parameters for faster training
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.7,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 30,
    "max_depth": 6,
}

# Train with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Predict on validation and test sets
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

# Calculate and print Validation AUC-ROC
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Save Submission to correct path
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"].values, "target": test_preds})
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Test predictions min/max: {test_preds.min():.6f} / {test_preds.max():.6f}")
